notes: Historical financials (revenue/net sales, continuing-ops pre-tax income, interest expense, D&A, cash/debt, and capex) are taken from DuPont’s 2025 Form 10-K (years ended December 31, 2025/2024/2023) and reflect the company’s continuing-operations presentation post portfolio actions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

EBIT is not explicitly presented as a standalone line item in the 10-K; therefore the EBIT proxy is computed as: (income from continuing operations before income taxes + interest expense). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))
D&A uses the cash flow line 'Depreciation and amortization' for continuing operations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))
Capex is taken from MD&A 'Capital expenditures totaled' for continuing operations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

NWC is modeled using a simplified working-capital build from the consolidated balance sheet (excluding cash and short-term borrowings; excluding discontinued-operation balances; NWC = (AR + Inventory + Prepaid/other current assets) - (AP + Income taxes payable + Accrued/other current liabilities)). 2023 NWC is set to null because the 2025 10-K balance sheet provides 2025 and 2024 but not 2023 in the continuing-ops recast. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

Tax rate uses a normalized cash-tax assumption (0.22) rather than the volatile GAAP effective tax rate disclosed in the 10-K. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

Cash and debt are taken from the 2025 balance sheet (cash and cash equivalents; debt = short-term borrowings + long-term debt). Restricted cash ($42M current) is excluded from 'cash' and may need adjustment depending on your DCF conventions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

Current price is sourced from market data (latest trade as of 2026-03-20 UTC shown by the quote feed) and used as an input for equity-bridge; it may differ slightly from the exact close on 2026-03-21 local market time.

catalysts: Execution and ongoing portfolio actions tied to the Electronics Separation and other transactions, including any related tax treatment outcomes. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Sustained operating margin delivery and productivity initiatives that can raise the earnings power through 2026–2030. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Capital return progress tied to the previously announced $2B share buyback authorization. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
company_overview: DuPont operates as a simplified specialty-chemicals platform following major portfolio actions, with continuing operations reflecting the post-separation structure. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

Continuing operations are primarily organized around Healthcare & Water Technologies and Diversified Industrials, with management emphasizing productivity, innovation, and margin expansion. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

The company is managing capital discipline (capex) while returning capital and building around end-markets with longer-term demand tailwinds. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))
current_context: Full-year 2025 net sales were $6.849B (continuing operations) with Operating EBITDA of $1.628B and Operating EBITDA margin expansion of +100 bps YoY to 23.8%. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

DuPont initiated 2026 guidance for net sales of $7.075B to $7.135B and Adjusted EPS of $2.25 to $2.30, with Operating EBITDA guidance of $1.725B to $1.755B. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

2025 cash flow metrics included operating cash flow of $560M and capital expenditures of $333M (continuing operations). ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Revenue base-case is tied to DuPont’s 2026 net sales range (implying ~mid-single-digit growth), then transitions to a conservative long-run growth profile. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Base-case profitability path assumes incremental margin progress, consistent with 2025 margin expansion (+100 bps to 23.8% Operating EBITDA margin in continuing operations). ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Capital intensity is anchored to historical capex levels (capex $333M in 2025) and maintained at a modest percent of sales in the forecast. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

Working capital intensity is modeled using 2024–2025 NWC computed from consolidated balance sheet lines (excluding cash, short-term borrowings, and discontinued-operation balances). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))

Tax-rate modeling incorporates the existence of operating loss carryforwards (NOLs), but uses a normalized cash-tax assumption for DCF stability. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))
key_risks: PFAS and related litigation/remediation cost risk (including potential allocation arrangements across parties). ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Separation-related execution risk (timing, tax-free qualification assumptions, and allocation of liabilities) that could affect future earnings and cash flows. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Commodity/input cost volatility and demand softness could pressure margins and working capital. ([investors.dupont.com](https://www.investors.dupont.com/news-and-media/press-release-details/2026/DuPont-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Forecast risk from using an EBIT proxy derived from continuing-ops pre-tax earnings plus interest expense (excludes a distinct operating-income line item). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001666700/000166670026000013/dd-20251231.htm))
